title: Asian Games: Jean Claude Saclag takes home MMA silver for Philippines

blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Jean Claude Saclag secured the Philippines’ first silver medal in the Asian Games 2026 despite falling to Otabek Rajabov of Tajikistan in the mixed martial arts men’s traditional -65kg final on Tuesday at Nagoya City Inae Sports Center. Saclag struck first, but Rajabov answered with multiple takedowns that turned the fight in his favor and brought home the gold–Tajikistan’s second in MMA. Rajabov earned the nod of all three judges.
